content: input-leap/Barrier GitHub issues (#1690, #207, #617, #576, #532, #1132, #107) document a recurring class of keyboard-switching defects: modifiers (ctrl/shift/alt/super) get stuck pressed on one side after a switch (esp. after screensaver unlock), input freezes losing control for seconds, dead-key/special-char breakage, and keyboard layout changing unexpectedly when crossing screens. These map directly to ilhop's own 'first chord after hop eaten / stuck modifier' defect class.
